mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, John Ehlers' twenty-period Correlation Trend Indicator crossing zero on completed four-hour BTC auctions identifies a reversal in alignment with an ideal straight trend; follow the new correlation sign for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long on a strict nonpositive-to-positive CTI crossing; short on a strict nonnegative-to-negative crossing
mechanism.why_distinct: CTI is the Pearson correlation of twenty completed close levels with a fixed increasing time ramp, jointly normalizing slope alignment by price dispersion and time dispersion. It is not a return sum, regression forecast, moving-average crossover, range path, volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the ideal-line trend reversal must coincide with completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse time-ramp price-correlation sign reversals are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.time_ramp: 0,-1,...,-19 paired with current through lag19 close so positive correlation denotes a rising chronological trend
features.cti: Pearson correlation of twenty uninterrupted completed closes with the fixed time ramp, invalid at zero price variance
features.event: strict finite CTI zero crossing from the immediately prior finite CTI
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed one-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical Ehlers CTI(20) zero crossing under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no period, formula, threshold, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: John F. Ehlers, Correlation As A Trend Indicator, TASC May 2020
external_basis.fixed_definition: Length=20 completed closes; Y=-count for count 0..19; textbook correlation numerator and denominator; zero-line crossing direction
external_basis.selection_use: published default length, formula, and zero-cross strategy usage only; no incidence or outcomes
